supersession_reason: V4 was rejected on selection: the best of three nominal state PPO seeds achieved only 100/192 (52.08%) safe successes on the 329000000 nominal selection tasks, so confirmation 333000000 remains untouched. A declared five-way controller screen on that selection family found the previously trained V19 seed-9351 controller strongest at 166/192 (86.46%), versus 135/192 and 152/192 for the other seeds, 150/192 for mean ensemble, and 145/192 for median ensemble. V5 freezes that checkpoint and uses fresh full-selection and confirmation families.
research_question: Can causal memory and factorized physical supervision compose an unseen recovery option under input-matched routing and a selection-qualified shared nominal controller?

representation.name: complete_current_centered_causal_motion
representation.definition: At each decision, subtract the current 57-D task geometry from every geometry frame in the causal prefix; the final geometry is identically zero for every method.
representation.runtime_causality: Uses only stored observations at or before the current decision.

shared_option_controller.matching_rule: The exact checkpoint is shared by causal, static, unstructured, heuristic, and oracle routers.

readme_release_rule: Promote the primary V5 result only if every primary, OOD, external, seed-count, and anti-shortcut criterion passes on untouched 334000000. An A/A+ general-method claim additionally requires configs/a_plus_external_peg_insertion_gate_v1.json to pass.
